original_query: What is a term that refers to the way work is assigned to the team?

confirmed.answer_text: "Command" refers to the way work is assigned to the team rather than the team deciding together who does what.
confirmed.summary: The image contrasts two team management approaches: Command and Control versus Self-Organizing. It explains that in Command and Control, a project manager assigns work and monitors changes, while in Self-Organizing teams, members collectively plan and take on work during sprints.
key_facts: "Command" refers to the way work is assigned to the team rather than the team deciding together who does what.
